review: Sometimes you look at certain Identities, and they make you wonder: What was going on in the Designer’s head? After so many powerful and interesting Identities in Season 7, we are now at such a moment with mediocrity incarnate, the new charge Rupture Identity [LCE E.G.O::Dimension Shredder Yi Sang]. Let's look at the new effects, passives, and skills first to get a broader picture. - Dimensional Castaway - A status that gives Yi Sang a shield before he is hit. It is mostly for Yi Sang to follow up after an ally’s attack with his Skill 1. - Quadricolor Dimensions - This buff might as well be called poor man’s shin. Yi Sang gains 1 stack after a follow-up attack, evade, and after using either Skill 3-1 or Skill 3-2. Ordered by the number of stacks, it is a simple 1 Offense Level, 2 Defense Level, +1 Charge Count from skills, and a meager 20% dmg buff is all that Quadricolor Dimensions does
